title: [FR E-Reporting] Add payment and invoice lifecycle messages
summary: E-Document message lifecycle infrastructure and French electronic invoicing support added to enable payment and invoice lifecycle communication with message queuing, response handling, VAT allocation, and buyer acceptance or refusal workflows.
key_points: New public E-Document message API with IMessageSender and IMessageResponseHandler contracts, payload persistence, queued delivery, response polling and retry
Generic applied and reversed payment occurrences with replay protection and links to the original occurrence
French Collected and Negative Collected messages for payment applications and unapplications, with proportional VAT allocation by rate and category
Buyer Accepted and Refused messages for incoming purchase invoices, with optional refusal reasons and only one response allowed
Incoming lifecycle messages are correlated by external IDs, with status normalization, transition validation and deduplication
